title: Mnesis Taxonomy Registry
description: Schema for taxonomy entries: one JSON file per closed vocabulary. A taxonomy is the SINGLE SOURCE of a value domain that travels between repos — annotation verbs (taxonomies/manipulation_v1.json, consumed by annotations/spans.jsonl `action`) and object classes (taxonomies/object_class_v1.json, consumed by ObservationLabel `class_id`, C12). Consumers MUST NOT invent terms: adding one is a registry PR here, not a local extension, otherwise the value domain drifts per consumer and fusion has to maintain a mapping table.

taxonomy_id.description: Taxonomy identifier, used as the filename stem and as the referencing id (e.g. 'object_class_v1').

version.description: Taxonomy version (e.g. '1.0'). Adding a term is a minor bump; removing or renaming one is a major bump.

description.description: What this taxonomy is the value domain FOR — name the consuming field.

actions.description: Verb terms. Present on action taxonomies (consumed by annotations/spans.jsonl `action`).

classes.description: Object-class terms. Present on object-class taxonomies (consumed by ObservationLabel `class_id`).

id.description: Term id — this is the value that travels on the wire.

category.description: Optional grouping for UI (e.g. 'container', 'tool'). Carries no wire semantics.

definition.description: The boundary of the term — what counts and what does not. This is what keeps two repos labelling the same thing the same way.
